tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: File transfers and peer speed tests in one place. Closing this list or changing pages does not stop a running task.
tasks.retention_note: Speed-test history keeps the latest 50 runs while this page is open. Refreshing or closing the browser page ends live connections. Clearing history does not delete files or chat messages.
tasks.action_failed: The action failed. Check the connection and try again.

speed_test.background_notice: You may close this dialog or change tabs. The test continues in Tasks, where you can stop it or view the result.
speed_test.title: Peer speed test
speed_test.description: Test this peer connection in both directions without selecting a file. Data is generated and discarded in memory; nothing is saved to the file cache.
speed_test.traffic_notice: Each direction sends for up to 10 seconds or 64 MiB, whichever comes first (128 MiB total payload, plus protocol overhead). The other peer must approve. Pause file transfers and calls for a cleaner measurement.
speed_test.result_note: Average received payload throughput, excluding file reading, compression and disk writes. This measures the selected direct/TURN route, not your ISP's maximum bandwidth.
speed_test.short_sample: The byte cap was reached quickly. A sample under 1 second may be less stable; repeat to compare.

errors.busy: A speed test or file transfer is already active. Finish or stop it first.
errors.offline: Connect to this peer before starting a speed test.
errors.unsupported: The peer did not acknowledge the speed-test protocol. Update both clients and try again.
errors.declined: The peer declined or the approval request expired.
errors.timeout: The test timed out. No complete speed result is available.
errors.closed: The peer stopped the test or the connection was interrupted.
errors.protocol: Invalid test response or mismatched byte counts. The result was discarded.
errors.failed: The speed test failed. Check the connection and try again.

about_dialog.title: About Weblink
about_dialog.description1: Weblink is a browser-based P2P chat, file transfer, file synchronization and screen sharing tool.
about_dialog.description2: It provides progress display, resume, folder transfer, clipboard transfer, file cache, screen sharing, and other features.
about_dialog.description3: This project is a pure Web application, no installation is required. If you encounter any instability, please try to refresh the page. Information will not be lost.
about_dialog.disclaimer: Disclaimer: This application uses P2P technology, all data is stored in the user's client (browser), the server does not store any user data, only responsible for forwarding signaling. Users should bear the risks of using it at their own risk, and the developers are not responsible for any data loss or privacy breaches.
about_dialog.star_repo: If you like this project, please give me a ⭐ on GitHub!

starter.welcome: Welcome to weblink, a chat, file transfer, file synchronization and screen sharing tool that can be run directly in the browser.
starter.tip1:
Please follow these steps to start:
 1. Set your name and avatar.
 2. Set the room ID and password to encrypt the signaling messages between clients, preventing others from joining.
 3. Share the room profile to invite others to join the room.
starter.tip2: If you encounter any problems or have any suggestions, please submit an issue on GitHub.
